title: Varsha
desc: After his mother's death and father's arrest, Sathya brings up his seven sisters like a father. But a villainous character from his father's past turns the siblings against each other.

title: Ellaranthalla Nanna Ganda
desc: When Surya accuses Vishwa Prasad, a politician, of acquiring his position through political influence, Vishwa swears to destroy him.

title: Ayya
desc: An upright police officer is up against a conniving group of criminals. To put them behind bars, he devises a series of unconventional methods.

title: Vaasu Naan Pakka Commercial
desc: Vaasu falls in love with Mahalakshmi and does everything possible to win her over.

title: Gaja
desc: A cat and mouse chase ensues between Gaja and a rival faction leader over a few startling events. Gaja tries to protect his friend, Krishna, and his lover, Shwetha, who are being targeted.
